# FingerprintHub fixtures

`snapshot/web-fingerprint/` holds real templates from
https://github.com/0x727/FingerprintHub at revision
`120898f9001a60e406311b12c8d0d5fbe4321a4e`, copied unmodified. They cover a
mmh3 favicon matcher (`solarwinds/web_help_desk`), a header word matcher
(`caucho/resin`), and a template present twice, once under a vendor and once
under `00_unknown` (`coldfusion`).

FingerprintHub is under the MIT license, Copyright (c) 2021 0x727 (`LICENSE`).
The copyright notice and license text must be kept when redistributing these
files. The README of the project adds a statement that the content is for study
and security work and not for profit; it is not a licence term, but it is
recorded here and in the source notes.

Do not use these files to infer upstream coverage.
